_comment: bosses-spacing (Docs/RESUME-bosses-spacing.md). Live: console `cire.Spacing reload`, or `cire.Spacing <outdoorBoss|waveBoss|packLeaderBoss|bossRadius|bossHalfHeight|radius|meleeBonus|pad|strength|separation> <value>`. Boss collision stays the Large nav agent (radius 72, height 300) so giants path the town streets; the body is drawn bigger per category: outdoor world bosses outdoorBoss x their Boss Spawn marker's size (route editor SIZE x, JSON "size"), wave/lane bosses waveBoss, boss-classified pack leaders packLeaderBoss. The older single sizeMultiplier is still read as outdoorBoss.
